name: dataverse-starter
description: Dataverse Starter template with PAC, Sparkle and ILRepack

scripts.build: dotnet build DataverseStarter.sln -c Debug -p:MergePlugin=true && powershell.exe -NoProfile -File scripts/ValidateArtifact.ps1
scripts.test: dotnet test DataverseStarter.sln -c Debug --logger trx --results-directory artifacts/test-results
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:artifact
scripts.setup: npm run plugins:init && npm run runtime:generate
scripts.build:release: dotnet build DataverseStarter.sln -c Release -p:MergePlugin=true && powershell.exe -NoProfile -File scripts/ValidateArtifact.ps1 -Configuration Release
